goal: Decouple the kernel library from application-level text translation machinery
Allow calling applications to format and present their own fatal and flush error messages
agreement: General support for kernel cleanup, but reviewers raise concerns about lost error details in the C API
Objection that replacing message strings with numeric codes loses diagnostic context (ryanofsky)
Unaddressed objection: numeric codes prevent C API callers from reconstructing error causes (yuvicc)
Concept approval after reviewing the commits (pzafonte)

categories.name: kernel
why: P2 because it decouples the kernel from application translation systems
Helps establish clean boundaries for libbitcoinkernel as an independent library
Advances the long-term project tracking effort to remove UI concerns from core validation
